summary: Custer County, Idaho L-4 cab built 1938, abandoned about 1954 and dismantled in 1983; a climbing guide saw old lookout windows stacked below the summit.

facts.status_note: Building dismantled in 1983; a climbing guide saw old lookout windows stacked just below the summit.

notes_for_editor: Agency conflict, unresolved: firelookout.com says Challis National Forest; Forest Lookouts and Idaho Fire Lookouts say Sawtooth. The record keeps Sawtooth and the story reports both. The 1938, about-1954 and 1983 dates come from the Forest Lookouts page alone, whose entries are credited to 'Kresek'. The 1946 emergency status is not explained in any source read. Access level is omitted because no source states one; the climbing guide does not date its visit (guide updated October 2025). Record events were empty; four events added. Record status gone and kind ground agree with sources.
